1.t: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-

2.t: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:

3.t: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-

4.t: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-

5.t: Taught man that which he knew not.

6.t: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,

7.t: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.

8.t: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).

10.t: A votary when he (turns) to pray?

11.t: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-

13.t: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?

14.t: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?

15.t: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-

17.t: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):

18.t: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!

19.t: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
